title: Understanding the activity origin and mechanisms of the oxygen reduction reaction on the tetramethyl metalloporphyrin/MoS2 electrocatalyst
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,9254-9264
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00814J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Tran Phuong Dung, Pham Tran Nguyen Nguyen, Viorel Chihaia, Do Ngoc Son
This study elucidated the impact of metal substitutions in MeTMP/MoS2 on the mechanisms and activity of the ORR. The Co atom is the best substitution in MeTMP/MoS2 catalysts, while the MoS2 support favours the dissociative ORR mechanism.
